name: Para Para 3
source:
Main character is blessed with great health, grades, amazing mother and a girlfriend. But there is a widow Momoko who comprehends his anxieties. She pulls him in a whirlpool of relations.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角擁有健康的身體、優異的成績、出色的母親和女朋友。但一位名叫桃子的寡婦理解他內心的不安。她將他拉入了情感的漩渦之中。
